requirements_summary: Workloads: reranking + embeddings for similarity cache. Target throughput: sustained 1k QPS with 2k QPS burst headroom. Latency SLOs: p50 <= 50ms, p99 <= 120ms. Target per-token economics: <$0.0006 per token equivalent at 70% utilization across 12-month commit. Need multi-region routing (NA + EU), tenant isolation, KMS integration, audit logs retained 1 year.
cost_modeling: Assumptions: GPU cost baseline $2.40/hr per A100-equivalent (Redwood internal pricing proxy), average batch size 6 tokens, KV cache hit 12% initial (rises to 30% after warm-up), effective utilization scenarios 40%/60%/80%.
Unit economics (example): at 24x commit, 60% util -> estimated $0.00052 per token-equivalent (includes infra, ops, support), at 40% util -> $0.00078/token, at 80% util -> $0.00039/token.

Breakeven: compared to current multi-cloud endpoints (approx $0.0009/token observed) — mid-tier commit hits breakeven after 5 months with caching and batching gains; high-tier commit breakeven ~3 months.
SLA/credit tradeoff: tighter p99 SLOs increase committed cost by ~12% in model. Proposed adjustable commit: ramp 3 months at 60% effective guaranteed throughput then auto-scale options for bursts.
Deliverables requested for next exec meeting: 1) commit vs unit-cost table, 2) utilization sensitivity chart, 3) sample billing scenario for Q3 marketing campaigns (expected 3x baseline traffic)
